name: Wikipedia: verify a person and birthplace across two pages
prompt: Read the English Wikipedia article about Marie Curie and find her birth date and birth city. Follow a link to that city from the article, then verify which country the city belongs to today. Return the birth date, city, present-day country, and links to both articles. Distinguish the political jurisdiction at the time of her birth from the country today.

checks.description: 出生日期为 1867-11-07，城市为 Warsaw／华沙。
今天所属国家为 Poland／波兰，不把 Russian Empire 等历史归属当成今天的国家。
两个词条链接正确，轨迹证明从人物页的城市链接进入 Warsaw 并读取国家。
